enableTiling.description: Enable or disable Tessera automatic window tiling

defaultLayout.description: Default tiling layout algorithm for new outputs and desktops

gapInner.description: Inner gap spacing between adjacent tiled windows in pixels

gapOuter.description: Outer gap margin between windows and screen edges in pixels

primaryRegionRatio.description: Width or height split ratio allocated to the Primary region in Primary + Stack

primaryRegionCount.description: Number of windows accommodated in the Primary region in Primary + Stack

perDesktopLayout.description: Maintain independent layout algorithms and options per virtual desktop

tileNewWindows.description: Automatically tile newly opened windows upon creation

showOsd.description: Display on-screen display notifications on layout and configuration changes

reconcileDebounceMs.description: Debounce period in milliseconds for coalescing window geometry reconciliation events

overlayPollingMs.description: Polling interval in milliseconds while the snap overlay tracks the pointer

ignoreMinimized.description: Exclude minimized windows from tile layout solving

gameWindowPolicy.description: Tiling classification policy applied to detected game windows

floatFilter.description: Comma-separated list of window classes or app IDs to float by default

customRulesJson.description: JSON-serialized list of custom window matching and placement rules

workspaceLayoutsJson.description: JSON-serialized map of per-workspace layout assignments scoped by output and desktop
